theorems.name: Submission.fvmb_trace_starProjection_comp_eq_sum_inner
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (B : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) = Q → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (Q.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ B.toLinearMap) = ∑ a, inner ℝ (τ a) (B (τ a))
